WITH failed AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS fail_rows
  FROM {database_name}.id.{table_name}
  WHERE {column_name} > CURRENT_DATE
    AND {additional_filters}
),
total AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_rows
  FROM {database_name}.id.{table_name}
  WHERE {additional_filters}
)
SELECT
  total_rows AS rows_total,
  total_rows - fail_rows AS rows_passed,
  fail_rows AS rows_failed,
  CASE
    WHEN total_rows = 0 THEN 'PASS'
    WHEN (fail_rows * 100.0 / total_rows) <= {tolerance(%)} THEN 'PASS'
    ELSE 'FAIL'
  END AS status
FROM failed, total
